verdict.rationale: The SDK's Eval() takes a `scores` array of scorer objects (gh-1/gh-2). The API, CLI and MCP docs mention managing, authoring and syncing scorers and functions, and online scoring runs scorers against production traces. This implies code-defined scorers plug into evals, but the only code example uses the prebuilt LevenshteinScorer rather than a user-written function. missing for 10: an explicit example or docs of writing a custom code-based scorer function (signature, return format, Python/TS), custom metric definitions, and independent hands-on corroboration.
